responsibility: Implements the AVX-512 IFMA + AVX-512VL intrinsic interface for 128-bit and 256-bit packed 52-bit multiply-add operations. It provides macro and inline wrappers for madd52 high/low forms with masking and zero-masking on __m128i and __m256i, extending the IFMA intrinsic API to VL-sized vectors rather than the full-width 512-bit forms in avx512ifmaintrin.h.
